name: video-downloader
description: Download 1s .ts files for each of the streamers you follow

scripts.start: npm run build && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=0 pm2 start "xvfb-run -a -s '-screen 0 1920x1080x24' node dist/main.js" --name video-downloader --update-env
scripts.restart: npm run build && pm2 delete video-downloader 2>/dev/null; pkill -f 'xvfb-run.*node dist/main.js' 2>/dev/null; pkill -f '^node dist/main.js$' 2>/dev/null; sleep 1 && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=0 pm2 start "xvfb-run -a -s '-screen 0 1920x1080x24' node dist/main.js" --name video-downloader --update-env
scripts.start3: npm run build && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=0 pm2 start dist/main.js --name video-downloader --update-env
scripts.restart3: npm run build && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=0 pm2 restart video-downloader --update-env
